newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scandia bid for Stashypotek floor for state stake.
newsitem.headline: Scandia bid for Stashypotek floor for state stake.

text.p: Swedish insurer Skandia's bid for mortgage lender Stadshypotek should be seen as the floor for bids for the Swedish's state's holding in the lender, a swedish official said.
Hans Jacobsen, a director at the finance ministry, told Reuters: "people have been saying that Skandia's bid was a floor...it's not a very good idea to come to us with a worse bid," he said.
The finance ministry has called for bids for its 34 percent holding in Stadshypotek stake to be submitted by next week.
Jacobson said it expected most bidders would seek complete control of the company. He said the state had not yet received any concrete bids for Stadshypotek.
Scandia has bid 11 Stadshypotek shares for 10 in the merged company.
